records.text: Blaine Holt rejected the claim that the bullet might have hit Charlie Kirk's spine and said something exploded on Charlie Kirk.
records.speaker: Blaine D. Holt

appearances.snippet: General, same to you. So this rifle, so this .30-06, it's a powerful rifle. What do you make of this narrative that the bullet might have hit Charlie Kirk's spine, which would explain why the damage wasn't what you would typically see with a rifle like that from that range? ... Absolutely not. I'm with Rob. Something exploded on him. But I don't have to get into the details because I'm not in a court of law having to prove a darn thing.

verification.notes: The Newsmax clip in transcript context records Blaine Holt rejecting the .30-06 spine-impact explanation and saying he agreed with O'Neill that something exploded on Kirk. This verifies Holt's stated opinion, not its factual correctness.
